svg.title: Supper plan domain: Tonight states, Weekly Planner, Portions and Groceries (Era 3)
svg.desc: Layer 3A shipped Supper Plan domain board for WFS Family Cookbook Era 3.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3
Shipped meal-plan continuity from Home (Tonight) through Weekly Planner, inline Portions & Groceries.
Part 1 · Tonight on Home (state first, action second, consequence alongside)
Ready GOTO leads with Make this tonight.
• QuickCaptureTrigger sits above Tonight (Capture a Recipe).
• Search opens recipe selection (Suggestions on Mystery).
• Take Out records a plan (incl. delivery), not an order.
• Ready GOTO adds Make this tonight above Search + Take Out.
• Family voting status lives in the bottom-nav Discovery
medallion (idle → voting pulse → Menu’s in), not on Home.
• Top row: context label + blush Ready in pill (white card).
• Food-led 5:4 photo + confident Outfit recipe title.
• Side-by-side Cook + Change plan row (wraps at 200% zoom).
• Cook opens Cook’s Mode; does not mark the meal cooked.
• Change plan: backup → original disposition → replacement.
• Quiet View ingredients disclosure loads dated projection.
An intentional supper plan (not an external order)
Recipe marked as cooked (Dismiss compacts to badge)
Part 2 · Weekly Planner, inline Portions & Groceries
Family note shown · tap to edit NonCookingDaySheet
and refresh failures persist with explicit primary/secondary actions.
Strip toggles to Recipes · no Review gate, no [4] reset:
Invalid exit or uncertain save → inline Hearth card
Portions refresh uses Garden status / Hearth Retry;
current week shows Add an extra composer at bottom.
Home, Weekly Planner & Groceries stay bound to one authoritative deployment calendar.
